units.source_text: 在这封信里，我对道子的养父母家表示了强烈的不满。

en.t: In this letter, I expressed strong dissatisfaction with Michiko's adoptive parents' household.

units.source_text: 果然，这不等于把道子出走的空想，首先告诉道子的养父母了吗？

en.t: After all, was this not the same as telling Michiko's adoptive parents first about her fantasy of running away?

units.source_text: 他们看透了她要出走，必定非常生气，还会去抚养这样一个不懂事理而又非常顽固的女儿吗？

en.t: Once they saw through her intention to run away, they would surely be furious; would they still go on raising such an unreasonable and terribly stubborn daughter?

units.source_text: 他们心里一定这样想：我这个学仆，从前道子所在的咖啡店的顾客，竟敢唆使人家的女儿干出这种忘恩负义的事，

en.t: They must have thought to themselves: this student servant, a former customer at the cafe where Michiko worked, actually dared to incite someone else's daughter to do such an ungrateful thing,

units.source_text: 还想谈人家女儿的终身大事，

en.t: and even wants to discuss the lifelong future of someone else's daughter,

units.source_text: 这该多么可恨，多么令人嫌恶啊！

en.t: how hateful, how repulsive that must be!
